title: A Trace--Logarithmic Variational Functional for Equidistribution and Alignment in Moving Mesh Adaptation
summary: Existing variational mesh functionals often require an empirical equidistribution--alignment weight or use a strongly nonlinear density. We propose a calibrated trace--logarithmic functional in the inverse pullback tensor $ A= J^{-1}M^{-1}J^{-T}$,with the logarithmic coefficient fixed by the local target $A=θI$. We prove strict convexity in the symmetric positive-definite (SPD) tensor variable, inverse-Jacobian polyconvexity and coercivity, and weak minimizer existence under explicit admissibility assumptions.
